method: provide_gate_actions over every plan's unmet declared gates, then action_resolvability.suppress_resolved with a fleet LiveState (plan_status + cleared_gates). Same path dashboard._gather_action_items uses.
interpretation: Before F003, 65 gate/approve NEEDS-ACTION cards were emitted, 64 of them pointing at plans that cannot act on the gate (completed/abandoned terminal, or draft pre-lock). With clears_when=gate_no_longer_actionable on the gate emitter, recompute (F002 suppress-at-source) drops all 64 phantoms; only the 1 genuinely-live plan's gate remains. This is the dashboard's 'Needs Action' count dropping to live-relevant work.
